content:
Machine Learning (ML) provides ML capabilities in the form of ML algorithms and remote models.
With access to these models, you can run several AI workﬂows such as RAG or semantic search. ML
supports experimentation and production deployment of generative AI use cases using the latest
externally hosted models that you can conﬁgure with connectors. After you conﬁgure a connector,
you must conﬁgure it to a model and then deploy it to perform prediction.
